body.name: Selected-complier marginal-capacity outer map
body.construction: For \(a\in\{0,1\}\), compute \(c_{axk}(p)=(2a-1)\{p_{x,1,a,1,y_k}/\pi_1(x)-p_{x,0,a,1,y_k}/\pi_0(x)\}\), \(C_{ax}(j)=\sum_{k\le j}c_{axk}(p)\), \(q_{ax}=\sum_kc_{axk}(p)\), and \(m_x=\min\{q_{0x},q_{1x}\}\). Set \(L_{ax}(j)=[C_{ax}(j)-q_{ax}+m_x]_+\), \(U_{ax}(j)=\min\{m_x,C_{ax}(j)\}\), \(Q_a^{-}(t)=\min\{y_j:\sum_xU_{ax}(j)\ge tM_{\mathrm{ASC}}\}\), \(Q_a^{+}(t)=\min\{y_j:\sum_xL_{ax}(j)\ge tM_{\mathrm{ASC}}\}\), \(\underline\Delta^{\mathrm{out}}(t)=Q_1^{-}(t)-Q_0^{+}(t)\), and \(\overline\Delta^{\mathrm{out}}(t)=Q_1^{+}(t)-Q_0^{-}(t)\). These last two quantities are outer endpoints; the sharp effect endpoints are the separate optimizations over \(\mathcal F(p)\).
inputs: an observed multinomial law \(p\) induced by \(P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\)
